sup:DEMO-C1.text:
Dear partner,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our proposal for your consideration. We offer a price of €16.00 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW.

As a growing supplier, we are very eager to build a strong partnership with your company and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your manufacturing needs. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We remain at your full disposal should you have any questions or require any further information, and we look forward to the prospect of working together.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

reply.text:
Dear partner,

We are following up on our previous offer as we have not yet received your feedback. We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

For your convenience, our current offer stands at a price of €16.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, and delivery DAP. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Please let us know if you require any further information to proceed with the allocation. We remain fully committed to supporting your requirements and look forward to your response.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

Dear partner,
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €17.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP.
We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
To demonstrate our commitment to this partnership, we are prepared to lower our price to €15.60 per unit, provided we maintain our terms of EXW and 45 days payment.
Shifting to DAP and 60 days payment would incur additional costs that would increase the unit price, hence we kept our standard terms to maximize your savings.
Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
